ai_summary: 63 moons technologies' overseas Wholly Owned Subsidiary invested Rs. 8.50 crore to acquire an additional 0.18% stake in its existing Indian unlisted subsidiary, Ticker Limited. This transaction is a red flag as Ticker Limited reported a severe financial decline in FY2025-26, with a substantial loss of Rs. 35.81 crore and a drastic 98% drop in turnover to Rs. 0.27 crore in the past two years, raising significant questions about the strategic rationale and valuation of this investment.
